meta.title: Florida Keys RV campground length limits

campgrounds.name: John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park campground
campgrounds.length_limit: Most sites 40 ft, a few a little longer (park page); reservation system lists max trailer length 62
campgrounds.hookups: 30, 50 and 110 volt electric, water and sewer at each of 42 sites
campgrounds.pets: Permitted under the Florida State Parks pet policy
campgrounds.stay_rules: 14 nights per reservation at most; 3 nights out between reservations; 56 nights per park in 6 months (Florida State Parks FAQ)
campgrounds.delivered_rentals: Not addressed: no Florida State Parks rule on delivered rentals
campgrounds.other_rules: Sites 24 to 32 take slide-outs on one side only
campgrounds.coordinate_note: geocoded from '102601 Overseas Highway, Key Largo, FL 33037' via Nominatim on 2026-10-14; OSM match: address point 102601 Overseas Highway

campgrounds.name: Bahia Honda State Park campgrounds (Buttonwood, Sandspur, Bayside)

campgrounds.length_limit: Sandspur (sites 49-72): 23 ft maximum, hitch to bumper. Buttonwood (1-48): no loop cap published; reservation system park-wide max trailer 48. Bayside (73-80): see height

campgrounds.hookups: Buttonwood and Sandspur: electricity and water (fee page says the utility fee includes sewer; amenities page lists none); Buttonwood dump station; Bayside: none
campgrounds.pets: Leashed (up to 6 ft) or confined; never unattended
campgrounds.stay_rules: 14 nights per reservation at most; 3 nights out between reservations; 56 nights per park in 6 months (Florida State Parks FAQ)
campgrounds.delivered_rentals: Not addressed: no Florida State Parks rule on delivered rentals
campgrounds.other_rules: Park may close when day-use areas reach capacity
